text:
Joan (CSM): Heads up—Riverview renewal is teetering. Procurement just asked to move to net30 + 6mo instead of 12mo and want a PO before signature. Onboarding activation is blocked until payment method confirmed. :grimacing:
Elliot (AE): Ugh. Do they want a price change with the 6mo term or just term change?
Joan (CSM): They asked for a 10% uplift on monthly rate if we insist on 12mo, otherwise they'd prefer 6mo at current rate but need PO first.
Elliot (AE): Can we offer a short bridge: sign 6mo now with PO, then convert to 12mo in Q2 with a one-time credit?
Priya (Legal): We can draft an amendment but need approval on the billing trigger clause. If PO arrives we still need an approved Docusign path or signed SOW. Quick clause draft: `If Customer issues PO and Invoice paid within 30 days, Redwood will provision Dedicated capacity within 5 business days; any promotional credit is applied as one-time invoice credit within 60 days.` Thoughts?
Mark (Billing Ops): PO is fine but vendor code will be needed. Also if they insist on net30 we need CFO ok for deferred payment on a renewal. PO alone doesn't clear revenue recognition.
Joan (CSM): FYI onboarding team flagged that SSO/SCIM provisioning can't start without final signed SOW + billing confirmed. Activation will slip by ~2 weeks otherwise.
Sam (Enablement): We can freeze the enablement schedule to a pre-activation checklist and run kickoff prep sessions in parallel so user's ramp isn't fully delayed. Do we have the customer contacts to start prework?
Joan (CSM): Yes, they gave onboarding contacts—we can pre-record the admin training and schedule user sessions pending activation. But the customer is anxious about billing timing.
Elliot (AE): If legal can accept a conditional amendment tied to PO arrival that triggers provisioning, that's probably the fastest. Priya, can you review my suggested line?
Priya (Legal): I can. Two caveats: 1) Need to avoid language that creates a constructive acceptance of PO as payment; 2) Add an escape if the PO is invalid or vendor code issue persists. Suggest: `Provisioning conditioned on receipt of valid PO and payment or approved credit terms.`
Elliot (AE): Works. I'll message their procurement to request PO + vendor code with a single-point contact.
Joan (CSM): Procurement asked about signatures — CFO is traveling and prefers an email signoff to avoid DocuSign delays. Any compliance concerns?
Priya (Legal): Email signoff is acceptable for this customer (we have prior signature acceptance on file) but we need the approving email to reference the SOW name and the PO number. We'll attach a short acceptance addendum.
Mark (Billing Ops): If they email-approve, Ops needs the PO PDF and approver name + tax info. Also confirm billing entity before we invoice.
Joan (CSM): I'll collect that today.
Elliot (AE): I'll offer the bridge credit option: 6mo PO today -> automatic conversion and credit applied when legal confirms 12mo amendment is signed by both parties. They'll likely take that to expedite. :crossed_fingers:
Sam (Enablement): Meanwhile I'll send the onboarding pre-kickoff and pre-record link to their admin so we can hit the ground running.
deploy-bot: Reminder: account-health-alert for #riverview — trial-to-paid conversion metric dipped below threshold (0.62) this morning.
Joan (CSM): Thanks bot. That score is why procurement speed matters — lower conversion increases churn risk.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft the addendum and post the snippet here by EOD. Can someone confirm vendor code and PO ETA?
Elliot (AE): Procurement said they'll try to issue PO by EOD with vendor code. I'll follow up now.
Joan (CSM): Update: procurement confirmed PO will be sent but CFO might sign by email tomorrow morning. I'll upload whatever arrives and tag ops. :eyes:
Mark (Billing Ops): Got it — once uploaded I'll start the billing flow. If email arrives instead of DocuSign, label the email `Accepted: Riverview SOW v1 - PO#XXXX` and forward to billing@redwood.com.
Elliot (AE): Sent a ping to procurement.
Sam (Enablement): Prep checklist posted to the shared folder. If provisioning happens tomorrow we can keep the original enablement week.
Joan (CSM): Closing loop—thanks team. Will update thread when PO hits. :thumbsup:
